identity.qualification: Hash manifests describe the exact reused input archives. They are provenance metadata, not a new execution or raw outputs. Duplicate archive member paths are resolved in extraction order (last member wins), matching the reduced EWD overlay.

identity_derivation.qualification: Identical immutable native input/module archives and same host/toolchain protocol as the earlier E2 campaign. Source/binary pins and all observations are new for this campaign; no earlier measurement is reused.

provenance_correction.reason: Template source/hash lines name unrelated old e2-base/e2-candidate trees. Actual build and all executed commands use the named frozen campaign trees. Those stale lines are not relabelled as this campaign identity. Machine/toolchain/protocol lines remain separately supported.
before_or_during_execution_evidence: Pinned source bundle and original staging/runner commands
Builder checks exact HEAD and clean tracked tree before each locked profiling build
Original build output records checkout/build paths
Every Valgrind stderr records actual executed path and arguments
Fresh input/module hashes are timestamped separately
collection_time_evidence: Frozen actual binaries with matching hashes and source/status files
Actual executable and all tracked source ctime/mtime precede first-arm stderr creation
provenance_correction.no_rebuild_or_source_mutation_check: Archived runner builds before the measurement loop and contains no subsequent build/source mutation. Collection-time filesystem timestamps are earlier than the first arm for actual binaries and all tracked source; actual hashes and clean HEADs match frozen artifacts. This is controlled-chain evidence, not a continuous filesystem or adversarial tamper audit.

results.qualification: Whole CLI instructions including startup; shared host, no wall-clock claim. Cachegrind and Callgrind totals are not pooled. W8 uses three paired interleaved observations per profile with genuine parallel-path proof; all counts/depth and null optional caps checked.

independent_validation.family_call_aggregate_qualification: The result family proof also includes closures/drop glue. Its inclusive instruction aggregate is used only as nonzero path evidence, never summed or attributed as optimization cost.
independent_validation.source_identity_qualification: Archived original pre-run staging script checks clean exact heads and builds524/ca2, then executes RSS375 paths seen in all28 original Valgrind headers. Corrected binary hashes and clean heads were collected later, not before execution. Ordinary-filesystem ctime/mtime chain and clean sources support no intervening source/binary mutation, but are not a continuous or adversarial tamper audit. The original stale e2 identity block remains invalid and preserved.

macos_startup_diagnostic.cli_method: shared macOS diagnostic; fresh CLI subprocesses; 22 interleaved pairs/cell, first2 OS/cache warmups excluded. Each fresh process resolves default RAM once; this is not a warm in-process RAM cache or quiet throughput benchmark. Explicit8g and memory-none controls retain profile default time settings. No wall-clock acceptance claim based on percent differences.
macos_startup_diagnostic.api_method: Shared macOS standalone safe API diagnostic, exact fresh release libraries linked with fat LTO; default system allocator (CLI uses mimalloc). First call resolves any default RAM once; next30 calls warm the same-process cache. Timing covers check_file before JSON serialization. This is neither quiet throughput nor the <=1% instruction acceptance matrix.
macos_startup_diagnostic.smoke_qualification: All stopped before checking with requested ceiling one byte, no invented counts/workers/witness/TLC class; safety envelopes omitted temporal execution metadata.

original_failed_gate_preserved.qualification: Superseded by strict sampling-contract assertions and normalization of only the two observed run-specific numeric fields, retaining all original whole-report semantic comparisons.
